title: 🔎 Ingest debug — why isn't a client's data arriving?

panels.title: ① Read me first — the decision tree
Runbook: $tenant shows no data — where did it break?

options.content:
**Read the tiles below top-to-bottom for `$tenant`. The first RED stage is where the pipeline broke.**

| What you see | Where it broke | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| Worker **write rate > 0** (stage ④) | nothing broke end-to-end | if OEE looks wrong, it's a *compute* issue → **Pipeline · Data eng** board |
| write = 0, **queue depth rising**, consumers = 0 | no consumer on the queue (worker down / SAC failover stuck) | check **Platform · SRE** → targets up; restart/scale stream-engine |
| write = 0, queue depth rising, consumers = 1, **capacity ≈ 0** | the single active consumer is **stalled** | check the worker's handler errors + DB (SRE → longest query / locks) |
| write = 0, **queue depth = 0**, consumers = 1 | nothing is *arriving* from the client | source problem → **MQTT connected?** (stage ②), **SparkPlug seq gaps?**, and **is the edge box online?** (SSM `packiot-edge` / reconnect watch) |
| write > 0 but **silver freshness stale** (stage ⑤) | data consumed but not landing | DB write path → SRE board (pool saturation / locks) |
| **Unmapped topics > 0** (stage ⑤) | arriving but the `packml_topic` has no active `packml_register` row | finish onboarding: add/activate the client's packml_register entries |

**Tenant → enterprise:** `cpack`→CPACK (ent 3), `bispharmastaging`→Bispharma (ent 5), `sbxcpack`→sandbox (ent 2000003). The silver-freshness table (⑤) is per-enterprise; match by name.

Deep dives: [Engine — stream-engine](/d/v2-engine) · [Bus — RabbitMQ](/d/v2-rabbitmq) · [Ingest — edge-transformer](/d/v2-ingest) · [Logs — Loki](/d/v2-logs)

panels.title: ② Source — is anything arriving at the broker?
MQTT connected (edge-transformer)
panels.description: max(edge_transformer_mqtt_connected). 1 = the transformer's broker link is up. 0 = upstream ingest is down for everyone.

panels.title: Broker receiving (msg/s, all clients)
panels.description: sum(rate(rabbitmq_global_messages_received_total[5m])). Broker-wide publish rate. 0 = nothing is being published at all (source-side outage).

panels.title: SparkPlug sequence gaps by publisher (1h)
panels.description: increase(edge_transformer_sparkplug_seq_gaps_total[1h]) by group_id (UPPERCASE, e.g. CPACK). Bars = lost messages in transit for that publisher = a flaky edge link. Shows all publishers (group_id ≠ the lowercase tenant token).

panels.title: ③ Queue — is $tenant's queue being consumed?
Queue depth — $tenant
panels.description: rabbitmq_detailed_queue_messages on stream-engine-q-$tenant. 0 while writes flow = healthy. Rising = the worker isn't keeping up (or isn't consuming).

panels.title: Consumers — $tenant
panels.description: rabbitmq_detailed_queue_consumers on stream-engine-q-$tenant. 1 = a worker is attached. 0 = nobody is consuming (worker down / SAC failover stuck) → data stops.

panels.title: Consumer capacity — $tenant
panels.description: rabbitmq_detailed_queue_consumer_capacity on stream-engine-q-$tenant. 1.0 = the active consumer is fully keeping up. Near 0 WHILE queue depth > 0 = the consumer is stalled.

panels.title: DLQ depth — $tenant
panels.description: rabbitmq_detailed_queue_messages on stream-engine-q-$tenant-failed. 0 = healthy. > 0 = poison messages this client sent that the worker couldn't process — inspect payload/config.

panels.title: Write rate by result — $tenant (THE end-to-end signal)
panels.description: sum by(result) rate(oeecloud_worker_batch_writes_total{tenant="$tenant"}[5m]). ok > 0 = messages are arriving AND landing. Flat 0 = broken upstream of the DB write — walk stages ②/③ above. error line = writes failing.

panels.title: AMQP deliveries by result (worker, all clients)
panels.description: sum by(result) rate(oeecloud_worker_amqp_deliveries_total[5m]). acked = processed cleanly; nacked_retry / exhausted_failed should stay flat 0. Not per-tenant (routing_key-scoped) — a broker-wide health check.

panels.title: Silver freshness by client (last 15 min)
panels.description: silver.equipment_values arrivals per enterprise. Match $tenant to its enterprise (see runbook). Absent row / high age = not landing even if the worker reports writes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ent.nm_enterprise AS "client", count(*) AS "rows/15m", max(ev.ts_value) AS "last message", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now()-max(ev.ts_value)))::int AS "age (s)" FROM equipment_values ev JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise=ev.id_enterprise WHERE ev.ts_value > now()-interval '15 minutes' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Unmapped topics — $tenant (onboarding gap)
panels.description: increase(packml_unresolved_topic_total{tenant="$tenant"}[1h]). EMPTY = healthy (no unmapped topics). Bars = equipment_values arriving on a packml_topic with no active packml_register row → silently dropped; finish this client's onboarding.
